query FlxStudioItems($first: Int = 60, $after: String, $folderId: Int, $kind: FlxStudioKind, $favorite: Boolean, $batch: String, $search: String, $allOwners: Boolean) {
  flxStudioItems(
    first: $first
    after: $after
    folderId: $folderId
    kind: $kind
    favorite: $favorite
    batch: $batch
    search: $search
    allOwners: $allOwners
  ) {
    ...FlxStudioItemPage
  }
}
